sloka: तस्य नैवास्थि न शिरो न मांसं ददृशे तदा ।गदया भस्मतां नीतं निहतस्य रणाजिरे ।। ७.२७.४९ ॥
transliteration: tasya naivāsthi na śiro na māṁsaṁ dadṛśe tadā ।gadayā bhasmatāṁ nītaṁ nihatasya raṇājire ।। 7.27.49 ॥

translations.english: Then, neither his bone, nor head, nor flesh was seen, as the mace had reduced the slain Sumali to ashes on the battlefield.
